reason: The frozen 102-feature model predicts `target_future_energy_kwh_per_km` over the next 5 km. TUM provides: SOC, speed, battery voltage, ambient temperature. Missing: GPS/altitude terrain (41 features), traction-motor features (19 features), per-timestamp distance (12 features). Without GPS/altitude, route-aware next_* features cannot be computed. Without per-timestamp distance, the 5-km energy consumption target cannot be demarcated. TUM cannot serve as an external validation dataset for the frozen 102-feature model.
blocked_reasons: only 30/102 frozen-model features are reproducible from TUM signals
investigation_method: PyArrow ParquetFile metadata inspection and row-group iteration (no pandas, no full-load loading)
investigation_conclusion: TUM TARGET STATUS = BLOCKED. The 5-km ahead energy consumption target requires GPS/altitude for route-aware features and per-timestamp distance for the 5 km window. Neither is available in TUM.
data_source: TUM EV UDS dataset (~96M rows, CUP1-CUP5, ID1-ID2)
